title: UI: StageArea fill/sample correctness — paint bucket fills whole shape via bbox, eyedropper samples by shape not region, plus wheel/async footguns
description: packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx interaction correctness. (1) Paint Bucket (:2094-2118) hit-tests with transformedShapeBounds (axis-aligned bbox) then applies the fill to ALL paths of the hit shape (hit.shape.paths.map) — clicking anywhere in a shape's bbox (even outside actual geometry or in a different enclosed region) recolors the whole object instead of the enclosed region under the cursor. Fix: use planar point-in-region pick to select the target face. (2) Eyedropper (:2122-2135) hit-tests by bbox then onEyedropperSample(hit.id); Shell.tsx:2712-2744 auto-switches Paint Bucket vs Ink Bottle by whether the shape HAS a fill, not by whether the click landed on stroke vs fill — docs/04 wants auto-switch keyed on the sampled attribute at the click location. (3) Magic-wand async select (:2152-2160) magicWandSelect(...).then(...) has no .catch() -> unhandled rejection on pointer-down if the bitmap decode rejects; add .catch that clears lasso state. (4) onWheel (:1936-1947, attached via React onWheel prop :4818) calls e.preventDefault() but React 17+ registers wheel as a passive root listener so preventDefault is a no-op (console warning + ancestor can scroll during wheel-zoom); attach a manual non-passive wheel listener via addEventListener({passive:false}). Confidence: confirmed (except onWheel visible impact needs-repro).
